help.app:
1) Library: browse, search, filter, and favorite songs.
2) + button: create a new song.
3) Edit mode: type raw ChordPro text and tap Save.
4) View mode: use transpose and per-song font-size controls.
5) Settings: customize chord color, autosave, and diagrams.
